description: This file defines an interface MessageMapperFactory responsible for creating MessageMapper instances and MessageMapperRegistry objects based on provided MappingContext and PayloadMappingDefinitions. It specifies methods to instantiate mappers with error handling for configuration issues.

classes.name: MessageMapperFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating MessageMapper and MessageMapperRegistry instances based on mapping contexts and definitions.

methods.name: mapperOf
methods.description: Creates an Optional MessageMapper instance for a given identifier and mapping context, potentially returning an empty Optional if no suitable mapper is available.

methods.name: registryOf
methods.description: Creates a MessageMapperRegistry based on a default mapping context and a set of payload mapping definitions.
